mapper.sql: tfwi.id, tfwi.task_id, tfwi.weight_type, tfwi.weight, tfwi.remark, tfwi.vehicle_front_pic, tfwi.vehicle_back_pic, tfwi.add_user, tfwi.add_time, tfwi.update_user, tfwi.update_time, tfwi.weight_no
mapper.select: select tf.carrier_name as tf_carrier_name, tf.license_plate as tf_license_plate, sw.warehouse_name as tf_warehouse_description, sw.warehouse_name as tf_warehouse_label, ssc.card_no as card_smart_card_no, sc.name as cus_name from task_flow tf left join sts_smart_card ssc on ssc.id = tf.smart_card_id left join sts_customer sc on sc.id = tf.customer_id left join task_flow_quality_item tfqi on tfqi.task_id = tf.id left join sts_warehouse sw on sw.id = tfqi.warehouse_id where tf.id = #{taskId}

select tf.carrier_name as tf_carrier_name, tf.license_plate as tf_license_plate, ssc.card_no as card_smart_card_no, sc.name as cus_name, sw.warehouse_name as tf_warehouse_name, sw.grain_variety as grain_variety, sw.grain_grade as grain_grade from task_flow tf left join sts_smart_card ssc on ssc.id = tf.smart_card_id left join sts_customer sc on sc.id = tf.customer_id left join warehouse_out_order woo on woo.id = tf.order_id left join sts_warehouse sw on sw.id = woo.warehouse_id where tf.id = #{taskId}
select , bui.name as add_user_name from task_flow_weight_item tfwi left join base_user_info bui on bui.id = tfwi.add_user where tfwi.task_id = #{taskId} and tfwi.weight_type = #{weightType}

select , tf.card_no as tf_card_no, tf.job_no as tf_job_no, tf.job_type as tf_job_type, tf.job_status as tf_job_status from task_flow_weight_item tfwi left join task_flow tf on tf.id = tfwi.task_id where tfwi.id = #{id}
